snippet.title: [UR] PMWC at EWC 26 Finals D1 | PUBG MOBILE WORLD CUP at 2026 ESPORTS WORLD CUP
snippet.description:
Paris. $3,000,000. One Crown. PUBG MOBILE World Cup at 2026 Esports World Cup ke Finals ab shuru ho chuke hain!

Duniya ki behtareen teams championship crown ke liye aamne saamne hain, lekin is baar ek naya twist hai. Kya champion ka faisla SMASH RULE ke zariye hoga?

Kai dinon ki sakht competition ke baad duniya ki top 16 PUBG MOBILE teams ne Finals mein apni jagah bana li hai. Ab har team glory, legacy aur $3,000,000 ke prize pool mein apne hissa ke liye muqabla karegi. Yehi woh lamha hai jiske liye har team ne mehnat ki hai. Group Stage ki behtareen teams aur Survival Stage se qualify karne wali teams ab saal ke sab se intense showdown mein aamne saamne hongi. Teen din, SMASH RULE, aur sirf ek champion.

Safar apni manzil par pohanch chuka hai, lekin trophy sirf ek hi team uthayegi aur apna naam PUBG MOBILE ki tareekh mein hamesha ke liye likhwa degi. Finals ka aaghaz ho chuka hai!

🔥 SMASH RULE kaise kaam karta hai?
Finals ke Day 2 ke baad Match Point Threshold ka taayun #1 ranked team ke total points +10 ke mutabiq kiya jayega. Jo team is threshold tak pohanch jayegi, usay Finals ke aakhri din kisi baad wale match ko jeetna hoga taake championship apne naam kar sake. Jis match mein team threshold hasil karegi, usi match ko jeetne se championship nahi milegi. Agar Match 18 tak koi team SMASH RULE ke zariye champion na ban sake, to phir standard rules ke mutabiq sab se zyada total points wali team champion qarar di jayegi.

🔥 PMWC at EWC 26 miss kyun nahi karna chahiye?

Paris mein duniya ki top PUBG MOBILE teams ko glory ke liye larte dekhein!
Har match high-stakes hoga jahan har point bohat ahmiyat rakhta hai.
Apni pasandeeda team aur region ko support karein jab woh $3,000,000 aur championship crown ke liye khelain.
Finals mein exciting SMASH RULE format ka maza uthayein!

Finals: August 14 - 16

snippet.description:
Paris. $3,000,000. One crown. The PUBG MOBILE WORLD CUP at 2026 ESPORTS WORLD CUP Finals Starts now! 

Best of the best will gather to compete, only one will rise to the crown. But there's a twist. Will the champion be decided by the SMASH RULE?

After days of fierce competition, the top 16 PUBG MOBILE teams on the globe have secured their place in this final stage chasing glory, legacy, and a share of the $3,000,000 prize pool. This is the moment every team has been grinding for. The best from the Group Stage and the survivors of the Survival Stage now go head-to-head in the most intense showdown of the year. Three days, SMASH RULE, and one champion.
The journey peaks here but only one team will lift the trophy and carve their name into PUBG MOBILE history. Let the Finals begin.

🔥 How does SMASH RULE work? 
After Day 2 of Finals, the Match Point Threshold will be set to the #1 ranked team’s points +10. Any team that hits this must then win a later match to claim the trophy in the last day of Finals—winning the same match where they reach the threshold doesn’t bring the championship. If no team secures the title via SMASH Rule by Match 18, the team with the highest total points wins under standard rules.

snippet.title: Outcast - Talhah Yunus | Prod. by Jokhay
snippet.description:
#outcast #talhahyunus #jokhay 

Written/Performed by Talhah Yunus
Produced by Jokhay

Lyrics:

Mic check 1 2, ustaad nahi guru,
Hogi baat rubaru, mera khauf huu ba huu,
Ghumay baat Hula hooop, besabaat kia kahun? kese yaad na rahun,
Ziada baat na karun, kia bedaadgar lagu,
Phelain saaray aag ki tarah na kar shuruu,
Ab dunya diwani mojaza e fan kahuuu,
Badla na mizaaj, kia hisaab mai rakhu,
Sina soz, Dil faroz, saari mehfillon ki jaan,
Le ye naaam dekh badlengay ab roop,
Shab o roz, kha ke chot, den sabr k imtehaan,
Bhar te jaam, intiqam khud se lu,
Khud se raabtay mai hu, jana subh ki ye bedari,
Haan mai paapi mai khilaari,
Han mai baaghi mai jihadi,
Dunya jaali, woh diwaaani,
Karte behas ye anaari,
Dil pe pathar, woh bhi bhaari,
Zimmedari, kalakari ye,
Baat ye hai ke log badal gaye,
Zulm ye hai ke woh maante nahin,
Rakh hogaye ghar bhi jal gaye, 
Beqadar hunar pehchante nahin,
Bethe shaam se waheeen,
gham e shaam tou nahi, 
Khelen jaan pe kayi, ye inaam tou nahi, 
Kese rokogay ghari ye,
Sab maangte nahi, 
Mehngay hon libaas,
Andar jhank tou kabhi,
Yaad kar kabhi, sachay dil se,
Lagay hain illzaam baray, banay baray firqay,
Yahan Sarken barbaad khoon charra sab ke sarr pe,
Qeemat nahi hai jaan ki koi Seekhe hue girr ke,
Chamber hai loaded, yahan chor bhi daku bhi,
Zinda duaon par ponchengay ansu bhi,
Aa kabhi jhaank un maaon ki ankhon mai,
Lashon pe lashen, pani pheren khuabon pe,
Nai aata baaton mai, nai ata jhanson mai,
Seekha jo sarkon se woh nai kitaabon pe,
Qaid imtehanon mai, sooni in raaton mai
Zinda dilaason pe kitne..
Kalakaar mere jese idhar kitne?
Shooter hai bhai aja dekh meri fitness,
Kuch mai ho ungal aatay woh pitnay,
Shehr nahi ye jungle, kha chuka kitne,
Waqt ye badalta sab karchuka witness 
Khuddaar hu mai kia ye meri weakness,
Presence aur blessings jani asal greatness,
TY in the building, all these motherfuckers wasted,
Banda khatarnaak bara, palla issi shehr mai,
Still at the top, abhi kooda tou nahi,
Laya phir se wave nayi, aja beta terr le,
Kia tu aag mai dooba hai kabhi ?


Dunya ye jhooti, sab ko apni hai pari,
Kia sab munafiq, chand hi mukhlis aaj bhi,
Jhutay fasanay sab sunaengay laazmi,
Paisa k aagay jhuk gaya kia aadmi,
Aadmi, aadmi
Badla na khud ko aaaj bhi,
Aaj bhi, aaj bhi
Kia hai koi qeemat jaan ki?
